---
automation: WoW - Money Vigilance
sequence_position: 2
subject: "The careful person's blind spot"
---

You track the numbers. You read the small print. You don't make careless mistakes.

And yet — the self-assessment still isn't done. The pension review keeps moving to next month. The savings rate hasn't changed in two years.

That's not carelessness. That's something else.

There's a pattern where the same steady attention that protects you from bad decisions also gives you a very convincing reason to wait. You need more information. The timing isn't right. You'll do it properly when you have a full hour.

This piece is about that pattern — and what's usually sitting underneath it:

[Why is doing my self-assessment the thing I dread most?](https://wayofwealth.co.uk/blog/why-is-doing-my-self-assessment-the-thing-i-dread-most)

Worth a quiet read if any of that felt familiar.

Joel
proposals.impact: Capitalises on highest-engagement segment; deepens sequence that is currently under-developed relative to its open rate
